nodes.name: 毛泽东
nodes.desc: 一师第八班学生，青年时期核心人物。
nodes.image_credit: 图片：Wikimedia Commons《毛泽东 1919 年在长沙》
nodes.desc_en: Student of Class Eight at Hunan First Normal School; the central figure of his youth.
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: Wikimedia Commons — Mao Zedong in Changsha, 1919

nodes.name: 蔡和森
nodes.desc: 一师学生，毛泽东挚友，新民学会发起人之一。
nodes.image_credit: 图片：Wikimedia Commons《蔡和森》
nodes.desc_en: Student of Hunan First Normal School, close friend of Mao Zedong and one of the founders of the New People's Study Society.
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: Wikimedia Commons — Cai Hesen

nodes.name: 何叔衡
nodes.desc: 一师讲习科学生（1913年入学，37岁，是当时年龄最大的学生），新民学会最年长的会员，中共一大代表。
nodes.image_credit: 图片：Wikimedia Commons《何叔衡》
nodes.desc_en: Student of the teacher-training course at Hunan First Normal School (entered in 1913 at the age of 37, the oldest in his cohort), the oldest member of the New People's Study Society and a delegate to the First National Congress of the CPC.
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: Wikimedia Commons — He Shuheng

nodes.name: 杨昌济
nodes.desc: 一师伦理学/修身学教员，毛泽东“印象最深的教员”，后来成为毛泽东的岳父。
nodes.image_credit: 图片：Wikimedia Commons《杨昌济》
nodes.desc_en: Teacher of ethics and self-cultivation at Hunan First Normal School, the teacher who impressed Mao Zedong most, and later his father-in-law.
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: Wikimedia Commons — Yang Changji

nodes.name: 徐特立
nodes.desc: 一师教育学教员，毛泽东和田汉的老师。
nodes.image_credit: 图片：Wikimedia Commons《徐特立》
nodes.desc_en: Teacher of education at Hunan First Normal School and teacher of both Mao Zedong and Tian Han.
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: Wikimedia Commons — Xu Teli

nodes.name: 向警予
nodes.desc: 早期女性革命家，蔡和森的革命伴侣。
nodes.image_credit: 图片：Wikimedia Commons《向警予》
nodes.desc_en: An early woman revolutionary and the revolutionary partner of Cai Hesen.
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: Wikimedia Commons — Xiang Jingyu

nodes.name: 萧子升
nodes.desc: 一师学生，毛泽东挚友，新民学会首任总干事。
nodes.image_credit: 示意图（暂无实拍图片）
nodes.desc_en: Student of Hunan First Normal School, close friend of Mao Zedong and first secretary-general of the New People's Study Society.
nodes.image_credit_en: Illustration — no verified photograph available

nodes.name: 黎锦熙
nodes.desc: 一师历史教员。
nodes.image_credit: 图片：Wikimedia Commons《黎锦熙 1924 年》
nodes.desc_en: Teacher of history at Hunan First Normal School.
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: Wikimedia Commons — Li Jinxi, 1924

nodes.name: 田汉
nodes.desc: 田汉：一师学生，徐特立的学生，后成为剧作家。
nodes.image_credit: 图片：Wikimedia Commons《田汉，1930 年代》
nodes.desc_en: A student of Hunan First Normal School and of Xu Teli, later a playwright.
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: Wikimedia Commons — Tian Han in the 1930s

nodes.name: 第八班教室
nodes.desc: 毛泽东在一师求学时的固定上课教室。
nodes.image_credit: 图片：百度图片《第八班教室.人民网记者 向宇摄》
nodes.desc_en: The fixed classroom where Mao Zedong studied at Hunan First Normal School.
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: web search — the Class Eight classroom (photo: Xiang Yu, People's Daily Online)

nodes.image_credit_en: Image: web search — the well on the campus of Hunan First Normal School

nodes.image_credit_en: Illustration — no verified photograph available

nodes.image_credit_en: Image: web search — the Junzi Pavilion

nodes.desc: 毛泽东在一师期间每天必去的地方。

nodes.image_credit_en: Image: Wikimedia Commons — the site of Hunan First Normal School

nodes.desc_en: The predecessor of Hunan Provincial First Normal School.

nodes.name: 冷水浴
nodes.desc: 毛泽东在一师期间坚持的体育锻炼方式。
nodes.image_credit: 图片：一师水井 · 毛泽东常年在此进行冷水浴
nodes.desc_en: A form of physical training that Mao Zedong kept up throughout his years at Hunan First Normal School.
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: the well on campus, where Mao took cold-water baths

nodes.name: 游学（社会调查）
nodes.desc: 1917年毛泽东与萧子升进行的社会调查活动。
nodes.image_credit: 图片：网络检索《正在湖南第一师范读书的青年毛泽东,利用假期,开始了他的"行乞"游学之》· 青年毛泽东在一师求学期间外出游学（社会调查）
nodes.desc_en: A social investigation carried out by Mao Zedong and Xiao Zisheng in 1917.
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: web search — the young Mao setting out on a study tour during his years at the school

nodes.name: 工人夜学
nodes.desc: 毛泽东在一师期间创办的工人教育机构。
nodes.image_credit: 图片：网络检索 · 工人夜学旧址（湖南第一师范）
nodes.desc_en: A workers' education institution founded by Mao Zedong during his years at Hunan First Normal School.
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: web search — the site of the workers' night school at Hunan First Normal School

nodes.name: 创办《湘江评论》
nodes.desc: 1919年毛泽东在长沙创办的学生刊物。

nodes.desc_en: A student journal founded by Mao Zedong in Changsha in 1919.
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: web search — the first issue of the Xiangjiang Review on display

nodes.name_en: Founding of the New People's Study Society

nodes.image_credit_en: Image: Wikimedia Commons — members of the New People's Study Society in Changsha

nodes.desc_en: A Hunan student movement led by Mao Zedong and others.
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: Wikimedia Commons — Zhang Jingyao

nodes.desc_en: Exercise methods that Mao Zedong created by combining traditional martial arts.
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: China.org.cn — exercise chart drawn from Mao's 'A Study of Physical Education'

nodes.name: 新民学会
nodes.desc: 新民学会：1918 年由毛泽东、蔡和森、萧子升等人发起的社团，湖南反帝反封建的核心社团。
nodes.image_credit: 图片：Wikimedia Commons《新民学会会员在长沙合影》
nodes.desc_en: A society founded in 1918 by Mao Zedong, Cai Hesen, Xiao Zisheng and others, and a core force in Hunan's anti-imperialist and anti-feudal movement.
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: Wikimedia Commons — members of the society in Changsha

nodes.name: 湖南第一师范
nodes.desc: 湖南第一师范（简称“一师”），前身为南宋城南书院，毛泽东在此求学并任教八年。
nodes.image_credit: 图片：Wikimedia Commons《湖南省立第一师范学校旧址》
nodes.desc_en: Hunan First Normal School (known as 'Yishi'), whose predecessor was Chengnan Academy of the Southern Song; Mao Zedong studied and taught here for eight years.
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: Wikimedia Commons — the site of Hunan First Normal School

nodes.image_credit: 图片：网络检索《"文明其精神,野蛮其体魄",那是适合任何时代的教育真谛》· 「文明其精神，野蛮其体魄」题词
nodes.name_en: Civilise the Spirit, Toughen the Body
nodes.desc_en: An ideal of all-round development that Mao Zedong advocated in his early years.
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: web search — the inscription 'civilise the spirit, toughen the body'

nodes.name: 经世致用
nodes.desc: 湖湘文化核心精神。

nodes.desc_en: A core spirit of Huxiang culture.
nodes.image_credit_en: Image: Wikimedia Commons — Yuelu Academy

nodes.image_credit_en: Image: web search — the inscription 'seeking truth from facts'
